The gap

Conversations you are already having, just not captured

  • 01

    Missed calls, missed revenue

    Every unanswered enquiry is a lead that quietly goes to a competitor instead.

  • 02

    Follow up that arrives too late

    By the time someone gets back to a lead, the moment of interest has already passed.

  • 03

    Customer context scattered everywhere

    Call notes, CRM records and support tickets live in different systems that never talk to each other.

  • 04

    No visibility into real conversations

    Leadership cannot see what is actually being said on sales and service calls, only what gets typed up afterwards.

The demonstration

What Rehan will show, live

Rehan Wickremeratne, Senior Partner Account Manager at Aircall APAC, will walk through these live on the night. These are topics for demonstration, not guaranteed outcomes for every business.

  • 01

    AI voice agents

    Handling inbound enquiries around the clock, including after hours.

  • 02

    Lead qualification

    Automated, consistent qualification from the moment a conversation starts.

  • 03

    Intelligent routing and handover

    Calls reach the right person with full context, every time.

  • 04

    Call summaries and scoring

    AI generated summaries, scoring and follow up actions after every call.

  • 05

    Zoho, HubSpot and Zendesk integrations

    Conversations synced automatically into the systems your team already uses.

  • 06

    Conversation visibility

    Real oversight across sales and service conversations, not just what gets typed up.
